title: Using street view images and visual LLMs to predict heritage values for governance support: Risks, ethics, and policy implications

bias_targets.methodology: Subdividing buildings into statistical areas based on the average disposable income of the inhabitants and comparing the share of buildings that received high predicted heritage value scores across these income groups.
Comparing the share of buildings assigned a high predicted heritage value score (> 50) located inside the capital city (Stockholm) versus those located outside of it.

Grouping buildings by their predicted facade material (e.g., wood, brick, stone) and comparing the predicted heritage values to determine if the model disproportionately undervalues certain traditional construction materials, such as wooden structures.
